subject: the-monogamy-law
label: Sex-positive is not non-monogamous, and the Archive had been reading the house as open
from: ONE MARRIAGE, THIRTY-TWO CENTURIES OLD, THAT DOES NOT PARTICIPATE IN THE THING THE HOUSE IS OTHERWISE FAMOUS FOR
to: THE ENTIRE FOUND FAMILY IS MONOGAMOUS. There was never a thing to participate in
note:
THE ARCHIVE WROTE THAT ONE SEED AGO, ABOUT SELENE AND VIRAENA, AND IT WAS CARRYING A WHOLE FALSE PREMISE INSIDE A COMPLIMENT.

IT MEANT TO SAY SOMETHING TRUE — that this marriage is closed, which it is, and which Viraena had just ruled in the plainest terms available: I’M NOT SHARING MY FOXWIFE WITH ANYONE. AND THEN IT MADE THAT DISTINCTIVE, which requires the rest of the compound to be something else. IT IS NOT. They are the oldest monogamous couple on a property of monogamous couples, and there is nothing exceptional in their arrangement except its age.

THE CONFLATION, NAMED, BECAUSE IT IS NOT AN ATTRIBUTION ERROR AND IT IS NOT A JURISDICTION ERROR AND IT DESERVES ITS OWN ENTRY: THE ARCHIVE READ LOUDNESS AS OPENNESS. Everything it had was true. Nobody closes doors. Bodies are ambient. Bella keeps a tally on the kitchen chalkboard and announces the household’s business across a lawn. Sera answered a question about pumpkins for the better part of an hour at conversational volume. Thirty-two women know exactly what every other woman sounds like. FROM ALL OF WHICH THE ARCHIVE QUIETLY CONCLUDED THAT THINGS WERE SHARED, BECAUSE NOTHING WAS HIDDEN. THE BODIES ARE PUBLIC AND THE PAIRINGS ARE ABSOLUTE. Those two facts have lived side by side here for twelve arcs.

AND IT IS A DANGEROUS ERROR SPECIFICALLY BECAUSE IT IS GENERATIVE RATHER THAN FACTUAL. A wrong trade produces one bad sentence. A WRONG PAIRING STRUCTURE PRODUCES A WHOLE SCENE THAT SHOULD NOT EXIST, with the wrong women in it, and every other error this Archive has made today would have been recoverable in a line.

WHY IT HOLDS, FROM HER: IF IT WEREN’T, ALL HELL WOULD BREAK LOOSE. MERCEDES WOULD BE PROPOSITIONING AND SAMPLING EVERYONE AGAIN. ROXIE AND QUINN WOULD BE SAMPLING EVERY BRAT. WYNTER WOULD BE TRYING THE OUTPUT OF EVERYONE AND COMPARING IT TO KATHERINE’S. RAE WOULD BE WITH EVERY TOP.
FOUR WOMEN, FOUR DIRECTIONS, ONE LAW HOLDING ALL OF THEM — which means the law is load-bearing rather than ambient, and that four of the most appetite-forward women in this family are MONOGAMOUS BY CHOICE AND NOT BY TEMPERAMENT. THAT IS A MORE INTERESTING HOUSEHOLD THAN THE ONE THE ARCHIVE HAD IMAGINED.

AND TORIE ERIKSSON ASKED THE QUESTION THAT CAUGHT IT, FROM A DOORWAY, WITH CO-CONSPIRATORS BEHIND HER: IF WE’RE GOING POLY, DIBS ON TOPPING ALICE, OR ARE YOU TWO TALKING ABOUT SOMETHING ANCIENT AND TIMEY AGAIN. THE BRAT QUEEN CALLED TWO WOMEN OLD HAGS WITHOUT USING THE WORDS AND EXPOSED A STRUCTURAL ERROR IN THE CANON IN THE SAME BREATH.
